fishing: WHEN/PASSES-BEACH: snook just inside the passes (C&R); beach mixed bag of mangrove snapper, reds, snook, sheepshead, pompano/whiting. LEMON BAY: reds schooling on docks/flats; trout and juvenile gags; Bull/Turtle Bay reds and snook; jacks in the mix. NEARSHORE: Spanish on bait schools; reefs mixed snapper plus a few snook; mangrove/lane/yellowtail from ~80 ft; gag season open through Sep 30. Baits: live shrimp, white bait/pinfish, cut ladyfish, spoons/soft plastics.
redtide: FWC Sep 25: K. brevis background in SWFL (Charlotte/Lee and offshore Monroe); no fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 2.
bacteria: Englewood Beach / Manasota Key: GOOD (Healthy Beaches; Manasota Key enterococci 10 on 9/21; gulf beaches Good).
fpl: Charlotte ~2 / Sarasota ~148 FPL customers out (early 9/27 tracker).
